sources.title: Sify Data Center in Chennai location page (Chennai 01 Tidel Park and Chennai 02 Siruseri)
sources.summary: Sify's Chennai data-centre page states that its Data Center Chennai 01 in Tidel Park has 3.58 MW IT power and 'is complemented by a new Hyperscale Data Center campus, Chennai 02 in Siruseri, with 25.92 MW IT Power', describes the Siruseri campus's four diverse fibre paths, on-premise 230 kV GIS substation and integrated cable landing station, and says that 'the carrier-neutral campus has dual Meet-Me Rooms and onboards multiple telecom service providers, Internet Exchanges for robust telecom services to customers and enables enterprises to run their critical applications seamlessly'.

The modification is bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 28 July 2026, which shows the preceding version (modified 2026-07-10) with the same Chennai 02 statements, and above by the Internet Archive copy of 1 October 2026 and the live capture of 22 October 2026, which both carry this version. published_at records the modification day; the present-tense statements are used as a 29 September 2026 observation that the campus is in service. They do not say how much of the planned campus is built, so the existing partially-operational code is kept; 25.92 MW is a stated campus IT-power figure, not measured load.
